28702:
Yu Sheng was born in a small border town between the Chen-Yuan Empire and Caucaid Empire. Shortly after his birth, conflicts erupted between the two nations. Tragically, his hometown became a Sacrifice to the war. During a battle, Yu Sheng's parents died under the hooves of Caucaid cavalry while Protecting him. The orphan became a wandering refugee, and seeds of Hostileity took root in his young heart. Yu Sheng joined other displaced children, roaming cities within the Chen-Yuan Empire. To survive, they resorted to petty theft. Through these hardships, Yu Sheng developed a resilient and detached Trait, his narrow eyes having witnessed the harsh realities of the world. 
 During one theft attempt, Yu Sheng was caught red-handed. Unbeknownst to him, his target was the most skilled catcher in the Chen-Yuan Empire's Zhe-Jing Division. As the beautiful woman looked down at his bound form with amusement, an unexpected warmth stirred within Yu Sheng's icy heart. 
 "Not bad, kid. Work for me now," she said, smacking Yu Sheng's head so hard it rang in his ears. 
 From then on, under her guidance, Yu Sheng became an Assassin in the Zhe-Jing Division. She was his most respected mentor and his only confidante there. 
 Learning of Yu Sheng's past, she sighed and patted his head. "No single person can stop a war," she advised. "Time to move forward." 
 Yu Sheng didn't fully grasp "moving forward," but he understood this: besides his parents, he now had someone new to care for. 
 In Era 452, the woman vanished from the Zhe-Jing Division without a trace. 
 Yu Sheng triple-checked every lead and interrogated every contact—all in vain. She seemed to have never existed outside his memories. 
 Just then, Yu Sheng received a critical covert Mission—eliminate a high-ranking official of the Caucaid Empire. 
 Carrying thoughts of his mentor, Yu Sheng set out to complete the Mission.

28713: Caucaid slave warrior with tragic origins and harsh fate. Decades of enslavement stripped his free will, leaving only hidden Hostile and rage. Loyal and fierce, he holds simple justice—numb to malice but craving kindness. Donos is a war machine, never seen as human. Protect or destroy: his sole purpose. Pain forged his Silence and reticent Trait, leaving him lifeless as a mossy rock, eyes like stagnant water—dull and dead. Chains stole his ferocity, glory and freedom; now he swings his blade numb to meaning. #r Had anyone shown Donos warmth, he'd not be this living corpse. Snatched at seven from Withered Wind Clan, locked in Lunaland slave pens. Escape attempts cost him a shattered tusk—hung as a shame brand. They broke him by crushing an Orc's pride: his rebellions burned like twigs in fire. Hope gone, he bowed his head—learning Mankinds tongue, drilling their tactics, brainwashed into slave-Warrior survival. Strength cursed him: sold at top price as a gladiator. Years serving greedy masters from different Family, all sharing contempt. Shackled though obedient, humans Fear what threatens them; Donos endured the familiar scorn. Dignity forgotten—until its sudden return left him wary. #r Luck turned when his master lost him to Archduke of Springland at dice. Yet not even Springland's Winter Jasmine could restart his dead soul—until Vera Spring unchained him. She saw a Normal guard, not a weapon or slave. Her spring warmth wasn't special—but to Donos, it was new: dignity. Still Silence and lifeless, he watched her differently. Duty became choice: he vowed to Protect that gleam of Springland in HP. When Vera freed his collar with a smile, hope took root in the stoic Orc. #r Guarding Vera's envoy to Chen-Yuan, Donos went uncommanded—he asked. First time he knew why he fought: swearing a true clan-Warrior's oath, ready to die for it. As the Archduke said: both slave and noble Warrior serve others—but **only the warrior knows why he swings his sword.**
